usageNotes: This is the deprecated path-based variant of pool updates; for environments using nested pools, use PUT /pools/ with a poolid query parameter instead. Use this endpoint to add or remove VMs/storage from a pool, or to update the pool comment. Callers need Pool.Allocate on /pool/{poolid} plus the relevant object permissions for any VMs or storage being added or removed.

examples.summary: Add two VMs and a storage to an existing pool

tips: Set 'delete': true to remove listed vms/storage from the pool rather than adding them; omitting it (or setting false) performs an add.
Set 'allow-move': true when a VM is already a member of a different pool and you want to reassign it — without this flag the request will fail if any listed VMID is already pooled elsewhere.
Returns null on success; treat any non-error response as confirmation.
Prefer PUT /pools/?poolid={poolid} for any cluster running Proxmox VE 7.3+ nested-pool support.
